caption: Core PDF print output with reading preview off. The native save step is intercepted.
Printable properties in reading preview.
eval: const p = app.plugins.plugins['properties-pdf-export']; p.settings.preview = true; p.settings.hidden = 'cssclasses, internal'; p.settings.order = 'author, date, status'; p.settings.layout = 'table'; await p.saveSettings(); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:app.workspace.getActiveFile().path,mode:'preview'}}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); const header=document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .ppe-header'); if(!header || header.getBoundingClientRect().height===0) throw new Error('Reading header missing'); return 'ok';

caption: The free compact layout.
eval: const p = app.plugins.plugins['properties-pdf-export']; p.settings.preview = true; p.settings.hidden = 'cssclasses, internal'; p.settings.order = 'author, date, status'; p.settings.layout = 'compact'; await p.saveSettings(); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:app.workspace.getActiveFile().path,mode:'preview'}}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); const header=document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .ppe-header'); if(!header || header.getBoundingClientRect().height===0) throw new Error('Reading header missing'); return 'ok';

caption: Free controls and optional Pro folder layouts.
Without Pro, Folder layouts shows no rules. Saved rules stay.
eval: const p = app.plugins.plugins['properties-pdf-export']; p.settings.folderLayouts='Reports = compact\nReports/Clients = table'; await p.saveSettings(); app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('properties-pdf-export'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.vertical-tab-content .setting-item')].find(el=>el.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent.trim()==='Folder layouts'); if(!row) throw new Error('Folder layouts row missing'); const field=row.querySelector('textarea'); if(!field) throw new Error('Folder layouts field missing'); if(field.value!=='') throw new Error('Folder layouts shows rules without Pro'); row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const box=row.getBoundingClientRect(); if(box.top<0 || box.bottom>window.innerHeight) throw new Error('Folder layouts row is not in view'); return 'ok';
